latestVersion.changelog: 🌐 Major Release v3.0: Multilingual Global Support. Now supports 6 languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, German) with intelligent auto-translation. Features: (1) Language switcher in web UI, (2) Auto-translated operation descriptions for all languages, (3) Multilingual dashboard and interface, (4) Same powerful snapshot and rollback features, (5) Ready for global teams. Perfect for international users requiring native-language operation logs.
